title: Final maximal-order performance receipt
objective: Produce a consolidated exact current-head public maximal-order performance receipt and truthfully assess every original acceptance gate without modifying algorithms

oracles: independent exact certificate checker and frozen corpus lattices

handoff.summary: Recorded a source- and native-hashed current-head maximal-order receipt with warmed exact-equivalent raw samples, stage traces, all 36 original acceptance gates, nine completion criteria, host-load context, a Markdown summary, and a self-integrity regression test. No algorithm source was modified.
risks: Measurements are from one shared Linux x64 host; small cross-run deltas are directional and unsupported platforms were not revalidated.
Magma was disabled and Oscar public/cold, complete Sage wrapper, randomized differential, and full stress-family matrices were not rerun, so their gates remain explicitly partial or unestablished.
The measured commit predates fixture-only vector010 completion 3ecf3eb8 and later OM p=2 source; the receipt records why the arithmetic/public paths remain equivalent where claimed.
next_steps: Reduce #2510/#1710 native-kernel ratios, precision12 composite-local time, and vector010 modular characteristic reconstruction before rerunning final parity gates.
Enable and validate the pointer-free worker capability, then rerun vector001 with genuine parallel execution and randomized completion order.
Rerun the complete cross-platform and external-oracle matrix, including bounded Magma and Oscar public/cold records, on the eventual integration head.
